title: Software updates
text: Extended cTWAS framework incorporate prediction models multiple molecular trait types across diverse biological contexts. Redesigned software interface improve modularity, implementing key M-cTWAS tasks standalone components. Users may run full M-cTWAS analysis via main function execute individual steps independently. Implemented “-LD” mode enables M-cTWAS analyses without requiring LD reference panel.

title: Software updates
text: Supports multiple prediction model formats, including PredictDB, FUSION, top-QTL. Provides streamlined preprocessing tools harmonize GWAS summary statistics, prediction models, LD reference. Offers utility functions constructing LD matrices individual-level genotype data loading LD matrices various formats, flexible support user-defined custom formats.

title: Software updates
text: Introduces new parameter estimation procedures enable sharing prior effect variance parameters across multiple groups molecular traits. Several schemes parameter sharing supported, including: shared variance groups variables (including SNPs); shared variance molecular traits; shared variance molecular traits type/modality. Compute standard errors p-values enrichment parameters. Implements new methods screen genomic regions likely causal molecular trait signals. speeds computation, regions subject full fine-mapping (allowing one causal signal). Supports fine-mapping single multiple regions, without LD information. Re-implements simplified single effect regression (SER) model SuSiE, incorporating new implementation null configuration. used EM speed computation. Improves computational efficiency ten-fold, enabling large-scale analyses across many molecular traits. typical M-cTWAS analysis using molQTLs multiple groups completed within 1–3 hours.
